tickets.body: The connector issues from December were supposedly resolved but some dashboards are still showing data gaps from that period. The connectors are syncing fine now but the historical gap hasn't been backfilled. Can you confirm if the missing data will be recovered, and when.

tickets.subject: Alert configuration reset after platform update
tickets.body: After last week's platform update three of our alerts have reverted to an older configuration - the thresholds and recipient lists have changed back to what they were months ago. We had carefully tuned these settings. Please restore the correct configuration. I can send screenshots of what the settings should be.

tickets.subject: API auth failing intermittently
tickets.body: Our API calls are failing intermittently with auth errors, maybe 1 in 10 requests. Started a few days ago, nothing changed on our end. This is holding up a dashboard refresh job we depend on daily.

tickets.subject: Report builder losing unsaved changes
tickets.body: Lost about 40 minutes of work on a report template when the builder crashed without warning. Second time this month. We need a more reliable autosave, or at least a warning before it drops everything.

tickets.subject: Still chasing the report builder crash
tickets.body: Following up on Erik's ticket from last week — the crash happened again on my end today, same symptom, mid-edit with no warning. Attaching the browser console log this time in case it helps.

tickets.subject: Alerts silent for two weeks
tickets.body: We just realized our operational alerts haven't fired in over two weeks — found out because a threshold breach went completely unnoticed until it hit our own monitoring. This is a serious gap and it's taken far too long to even notice.

tickets.subject: Report builder issue from November still not fixed
tickets.body: It's been almost two months since we first raised the report builder crash and it's still happening. We've now lost work three separate times. I don't understand why this is taking so long to fix.

tickets.subject: Export broken on top of everything else
tickets.body: Now exports are failing too, on the same day we're already dealing with the unresolved report builder issue. Feels like things are falling apart one at a time.

tickets.subject: Escalating — report builder crash, three months running
tickets.body: I need this escalated. The report builder crash has been open since October, we've lost work repeatedly, and every update says it's 'being investigated.' We need a real fix or a real timeline, not another status update.

tickets.subject: Seat provisioning broken, still waiting on a resolution
tickets.body: Adding to the pile — new hires can't get seats provisioned properly, permissions come through wrong every time. Given everything else that's been open for months, I'd like a call with someone who can actually own this, not another ticket in the queue.

tickets.subject: Report builder crash back — following up on the escalation
tickets.body: Coming back to this after the quiet spell — the report builder is crashing again on save, same pattern as the issue we escalated in the spring. Given the history here, please treat this as a continuation, not a new low-priority ticket.

tickets.subject: Export fix confirmed working
tickets.body: Wanted to confirm the export fix from the recent round of changes is holding up on our end — ran the full weekly batch without issue for the first time in a while. Also flagging one small formatting glitch on the CSV header row, low priority.

tickets.subject: Alerts reliability check-in
tickets.body: Following the recent fixes, our alerts have been firing consistently again, which is a relief after everything earlier this year. One question — is there a way to get a weekly summary confirming alerts ran, just as an extra safety net on our end?

tickets.subject: Second alert question — grouping by team
tickets.body: Building on the alerts conversation from a few weeks back, is it possible to group alert recipients by team rather than one flat list? Would help us route the right issues to the right people.

tickets.subject: Dashboard drill-down request
tickets.body: Small one — would love a drill-down option on the regional summary tile so we can click through to the underlying report directly. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have we noticed while things have been running smoothly.

tickets.subject: Export scheduling for new team
tickets.body: We're onboarding a new regional team and want to set up a scheduled export for them similar to ours. Could you point us to the setup steps, or is there a way to clone an existing schedule?
